buildCommand: test -n "$VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL" || { echo 'VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL is unset: astro.config.ts needs it for canonical URLs, the sitemap and og:image. Turn on "Automatically expose System Environment Variables" in the Vercel project settings.'; exit 1; }; test "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = false || { echo 'This is a shallow clone: Starlight dates every page from git history (lastUpdated in astro.config.ts). Set VERCEL_DEEP_CLONE=true in the Vercel project environment variables.'; exit 1; }; bunx astro build
